name: Offended Epitaphs
disable: three DC 20 Diplomacy check, DC 20 Occultism check, or DC 20 Religion check checks to rebuke the cantankerous spirits
routine: (2 actions) Ancestral spirits appear throughout areas D1 and D2, each fading after several rounds to be replaced by a different spirit.

items.name: Growing Grumbles
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of area D2

---

Effect The haunt rolls initiative as the ancestral spirits begin manifesting.

items.name: Lambast
items.text:
A spirit yells at a living creature, which must attempt a DC 18 Will save save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 2 persistent,mental damage. Until the persistent damage ends, the creature can perceive ghostly Dwarven inscriptions floating several inches in front of the various inscriptions throughout the park.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes 4 persistent,mental damage and is Stupefied 1 until the persistent damage ends.

text: Funerary inscriptions flicker and display different messages, causing ghostly ancestors to briefly appear and complain that their descendants have forgotten them.
